recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not revert the current cardinality, search parameters, or CodeableReference shape toward the original FHIR-36164 comment snippet; those differences are later accepted work-group refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-36164 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Imaging Integration change request asking that ImagingSelection.bodySite become a CodeableReference able to reference BodyStructure while still allowing a coded body-site value.
initial_application: Commit 1891df8e49d773c1958178726f7399e5f5bd7e7e applied the seed by changing source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml from Coding to CodeableReference with targetProfile BodyStructure and by changing the existing body-site search parameter expression to ImagingSelection.bodySite.concept; the Jira comment also recorded that the token search parameter was kept.
additional_context: ImagingSelection and BodyStructure are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Later final decisions explain the current differences from the original Jira XML snippet: FHIR-36787 rejected removing bodySite, FHIR-40276 added the BodyStructure reference search parameter, FHIR-45274 changed bodySite to 0..* and updated alias/mapping, FHIR-46918 rejected a separate laterality element, and FHIR-50859 later kept CodeableReference while adding bodySite/laterality guidance. FHIR-36165 and FHIR-50859 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current StructureDefinition defines ImagingSelection.bodySite as 0..* CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure, the search parameter bundle supports both bodySite.concept and bodySite.reference, and the notes explain coded and BodyStructure representations.
